Name: CP Anime Portraits HiYou Style
Author: Hayato2236
Description:
Un simple mod para los retratos de [b]Stardew Valley Vanilla[/b]

Requiere [b]Content Patcher [/b]y opcionalmente [b]Generic Config Menu mod

[/b]Compatible con [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters y [CP] Miru's Krobus Portraits and Characters, solo deben eliminar la carpeta [Portraits] de estos mods si desean usar sus sprites
Utilice Stable Difffusion y el CPKT[b] [HiYou] [/b]de la Youtuber [b]Future Diffusion[/b]El proceso fue img2img utilizando los retratos originales, en algunos casos txt2img y photoshop para otros ajustes

[b]Englsh text[/b]

A simple mod for[b] Stardew Valley Vanilla[/b] portraits

Requires[b] Content Patcher[/b] and optionally [b]Generic Config Menu mod
[/b]
Compatible with [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters and [CP] Miru's Krobus Portraits and Characters, you just need to delete the [Portraits] folder of these mods if you want to use their sprites

Use Stable Diffusion and CKPT[b] [HiYou][/b] from Youtuber [b]Future Diffusion[/b]The process was img2img using the original portraits, in some cases txt2img and photoshop for other adjustments
